# Bundled studio fonts

- Raleway variable weights 400–600: interface text, subset to the planner's Latin characters and punctuation.
- Allura regular: the decorative venue wordmark, subset to its display text.

Both files are WOFF2 subsets supplied by Google Fonts, distributed under SIL Open Font License 1.1. Original copyright notices and licenses are retained beside the files. The build embeds both font files and the full common license terms in the standalone HTML, and includes separate license files under `dist/licenses/`.

The styling takes cues from the venue's pale sage palette, light typography, script headings and fine rules. Allura provides the handwritten heading, with both fonts redistributed under the included OFL licenses.

Upstream sources:

- https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/raleway
- https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/allura
